description: 白王精确过渡，逼着黑王失去控制格，推b兵升变
explanation_en: White uses precise king maneuvers to put Black in zugzwang and take control of key squares. After the c-pawn sacrifice draws away Black's b-pawn, the b-pawn promotes.

intro.popup: 💡 逼着：看似简单，白方如何通过精确走位，逼着黑王失去关键位置，最终推b兵升变？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Zugzwang: The position looks simple. How can White use precise king moves to force Black off key squares and promote the b-pawn?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：白王通过等招过渡，一步步逼着黑王暴露弱点，c6牺牲引走黑兵，b7快速升变！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: White uses triangulation to force the king to yield key squares. The c6 pawn sacrifice draws away Black's pawn, allowing b7 to promote.

moves.popup: 白王Kd4，等招！逼着黑王亮出意图。
moves.popup_en: White plays Kd4 as a waiting move, forcing Black to reveal its plan.
The black king retreats to c8 and has no good move.
The white king moves to e5 and takes an active position.
The black king moves to d7 to stop the c-pawn from advancing.
The white king moves to d5, controls c6, and prepares to advance the c-pawn.

moves.popup: 黑王Ke7，被迫离开d7，无法同时守住c6和b6。
moves.popup_en: The black king is forced to e7, leaving d7 and unable to guard both c6 and b6.
White advances the c-pawn to c6, forcing Black to respond.

moves.popup: 黑方bxc6+，被迫吃兵（否则c7直接升变）。
moves.popup_en: Black is forced to capture with bxc6+, or the pawn will advance to c7 and promote.
The white king recaptures on c6 and protects the pawn on b6.
The black king moves to e6 in a final attempt to resist.

moves.popup: b7！b兵大步前进，升变无法阻拦！
moves.popup_en: The b-pawn advances to b7 and cannot be stopped from promoting.
The king moves to e5 but cannot reach b8 in time.

moves.popup: b8=Q+！升变为后将军，白方获胜！
moves.popup_en: The pawn promotes to a queen with check on b8, and White wins.
